_comment: Minimal OpenBB MCP profile — admin/discovery tools only, load categories on demand. Useful for multi-tenant or resource-constrained deployments. Copy to ~/.openbb_platform/mcp_settings.json to use.
OPENBB_MCP_DESCRIPTION: OpenBB MCP in minimal mode. Only admin and discovery tools are active by default. Use available_categories() and activate_tools() to load data tools on demand.
_note: Start by calling available_categories() to see what tool groups exist, then activate_tools() to enable what you need. No data tools are pre-loaded so context windows stay small.
